segments.name: Life insurance
segments.evidence: The life insurance segment is engaged in the business of selling and servicing selected lines of life insurance, annuity products, and accident and health insurance.

segments.name: Cemetery and mortuary
segments.description: Operates mortuaries and cemeteries in Utah, California, and New Mexico and sells pre-need funeral, cemetery, mortuary, and cremation services.
segments.evidence: The Company also engages in pre-need selling of funeral, cemetery, mortuary, and cremation services through its cemetery and mortuary locations.

segments.name: Mortgages
segments.description: Originates, underwrites, and purchases residential and commercial mortgage loans for new construction, existing homes, and other real estate projects.
segments.evidence: The mortgage segment originates and underwrites or otherwise purchases residential and commercial loans for new construction, existing homes, and other real estate projects.

revenueModel.text: Policyholders pay premiums on life insurance and accident and health policies and deposits on annuity contracts, customers purchase funeral and cemetery services and pre-need contracts, and borrowers obtain residential and commercial mortgage loans.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sells its life insurance products through direct agents, brokers, and independent licensed agents who may also sell insurance products of other companies.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company discontinued its low-cost comprehensive diver's accident insurance policy.
changes.evidence: This product was discontinued in March 2024.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company completed a merger with FOXO Life Insurance Company.
changes.evidence: and merger with FOXO Life Insurance Company (2023).
